proposals.old_text: Classify the input into exactly one of: urgent, billing, technical, feature, security, other.
proposals.new_text: Classify the input into one or more of: urgent, billing, technical, feature, security, other.
proposals.hypothesis: Changing 'exactly one of' to 'one or more of' allows for multiple categories to be returned, which is necessary for inputs that clearly fit into more than one category.
proposals.expected_improvement: This change should help the model correctly classify inputs that belong to multiple categories, reducing the number of classification errors.

proposals.new_text: Output the category name(s) as a comma-separated list.
proposals.hypothesis: Specifying that the output can be a comma-separated list will guide the model to provide multiple categories when applicable.
proposals.expected_improvement: This change should help the model understand that it can output multiple categories, aligning with the expected outputs in the failed traces.

proposals.new_text: No explanation. No reasoning. If multiple categories apply, list them all.
proposals.hypothesis: Clarifying that if multiple categories apply, they should all be listed will reinforce the model's understanding of the task requirements.
proposals.expected_improvement: This change should help the model avoid omitting relevant categories in its output, thus improving classification accuracy.
